event.description:
We’ve got the perfect class coming for anyone who likes their Halloween with a little more moo than boo!

Join us for a fun, step-by-step canvas class featuring an adorable spooky-season Highland cow.

No painting experience is needed—we’ll guide you through the entire project and help you create a canvas you’ll be excited to pull out every Halloween. Bring a friend, make it a girls’ night or date night, and enjoy a creative evening with just the right mix of cute, creepy, and cozy fall vibes.

We are excited to offer a selection of alcoholic beverages!  Your first beverage of the evening is included with your booking, and another can be purchased at the event!  Choose from a variety of local wines, ice cold beers, ciders, and seltzers! We have something for everyone. If you would rather skip the liquor, we also have sodas, coffee, and water available for you! A snack is also included in your reservation fee, but feel free to bring in your favorite food to munch on while you paint!

These tickets are not transferable, and the deposit is not refundable but does apply to your ticket that evening.  Your fee can be applied to a different class if you cannot attend this one or gifted to a friend if you let us know that you would like to do that in advance.  Our number is (970) 243-0886.  Do not purchase tickets from strangers on the internet.

Messy Hands Art Club is a hands-on homeschool art class designed for curious, creative students ages 7–12 who love to make (and don’t mind getting a little messy along the way!). Held in our studio, this class invites young artists to explore, experiment, and build skills in a relaxed and encouraging environment.

Over the course of the program, students will work with a variety of art mediums—including watercolor, acrylic paint, clay, and more—while learning techniques, creative problem-solving, and artistic confidence. Each session offers a new project and plenty of room for self-expression.

All supplies are included—just bring your creativity and a willingness to get your hands messy!

event.description:
Join us for the October meeting of our Pottery Studio Book Club!
No assigned reading, no pressure — just good conversation, wine, and creativity. Bring a book you’ve read recently and loved (it can be one you’re currently reading or something you finished earlier this year). We’ll each share what’s been lighting up our bookshelves, sip a glass of wine, and make something beautiful together.

You have two options: you can reserve a ticket for the month’s craft, prepared for you to enjoy while we talk books, or you can just reserve a ticket for the event that includes a drink (wine, beer, seltzers, ciders, or non-alcoholic).

This month’s craft: Book Bags
Choose one of preselected vinyl designs, and we will press it onto a book bag for you and we will paint them the night of the class!

The deposit for this event is applied directly to the full cost of the event that evening.  This deposit is not refundable and not transferable.  Please do not buy one from strangers on social media.

event.description:
We are back at the Reckless Roadhouse in DeBeque with another Pottery Painting Party! This one is a celebration of Spooky Season and your favorite Halloween movies. We can help you make a mug or beer stein inspired by Beetlejuice, Hocus Pocus, a wide range of Horror movies, Nightmare Before Christmas, and more! We are bringing a wide range of ceramic mugs and beer steins for you to choose from, as well as our full collections of Halloween silkscreens. No experience is required — we will bring everything you need to make a masterpiece. We’ll even buy your first drink to get the party started! The total cost for the event is $50.

These tickets are not transferable, and the deposit is not refundable but does apply to your ticket that evening. Your fee can be applied to a different class if you cannot attend this one or gifted to a friend if you let us know that you would like to do that in advance.  Our number is (970) 243-0886. Please do not buy tickets from strangers on the internet.

If The Shoe Fits – Key West FINALS
event.description:
Six National Finalists representing Dallas, NYC, Minneapolis, L.A., N Florida, and S Florida all vie to become the NEW “Queen of NYE”!

Featuring reigning QUEEN of New Year’s Eve MULAN ALEXANDER plus the ORIGINAL star of the High Heel Shoe Drop, SUSHI!”

  • “IF THE SHOE FITS”, presented by Bourbon Street Pub /New Orleans House and The Monroe County Tourist Development Council, has returned for its 2nd annual whirl-wind tour, completing six fantastic shows across the United States and now brings it all home for the 10/10/2026 NATIONAL FINALS! The street closure is approved, the enhanced NYE state is ready to be built, incredible special guest performers and judges are confirmed, and we invite all our Key West friends and family plus visiting guests from across the country to join us FOR FREE on Saturday, October 10th at 8pm sharp!

CNN has already confirmed to once again cover the Shoe Drop on New Year’s Eve, and we have six sensational finalists ready to slay three categories to try to become the STAR of the 29th annual Extravaganza! Not to mention win 2k cash and a custom, couture outfit to debut on NYE hand created by SUSHI!

Our National FInalists:

Dallas, Texas (The Round-Up): Jada Pinkett Fox

New York City (RedEye NY): FiFi DuBois

Minneapolis (Gay ’90s): Brandii Benet

West Hollywood/L.A. (The Abbey Food and Bar): Calypso Jete

North Florida ( InCahoots Jacksonville): Arsyn Ick

South Florida (Hunter’s Wilton Manors): TP Lords

RSVP here on Eventbrite to join us with no cover as we find out once and for all IF THE SHOE FITS!

Judges include:

  • Joey Schroeder, creator of the High Heel Shoe Drop and owner Bourbon Street Pub/New Orleans House Key West
  • Sushi, Original “Queen of New Year’s Eve” for 25 years
  • Bria Ansara, Long-time Show Director and Host of the High Heel Shoe Drop stage show + 2024 “Key West Entertainer of the Year”
  • Jeff Smead, General Manager for Island House Key West, national supporting partner for “If the Shoe Fits”
  • A. Mark Gardner, General Manager of the NEW Aqua Key West

Emceed by Patrik G., co-host of the annual High Heel Shoe Drop, emcee of the “If the Shoe Fits” National Tour, and Global LGBTQ+ Ambassador

Step-down performances by first-ever and reigning “If the Shoe Fits” national champion MULAN ALEXANDER, brought to Key West for the National Finals thanks to the generosity of the “If the Shoe Fits” official travel partner HE TRAVEL!

Special guest performances by 2025 “If the Shoe Fits” South Florida Champion Beatrix Dixie, Bria Ansara, Jessica Devereaux, Holly Dae, and Stevie B. Lords

For more information visit http://bourbonstpub.com/iftheshoefits/ and http://www.facebook.com/iftheshoefitskw

Discover why the Florida Keys are “Close To Perfect-Far From Normal” at https://fla-keys.com/

Prizing Courtesy of Bourbon Street Pub /New Orleans House, The Monroe County Tourist Development Council and Island House Key West

event.title: Fantasy Fest and Goombay 2026
event.description:
Fantasy Fest is Key West’s legendary 10-day party in paradise — a vibrant celebration of creativity, community, and pure island magic. What began in 1979 as a local idea to liven up the island’s quiet season has transformed into an internationally recognized festival that takes over the streets of Old Town every October.

Each year, artists, adventurers, and free spirits from around the world flock to Key West to transform the island with spectacular costumes, lively parades, and unforgettable parties. Imagination runs wild, costumes turn heads, and the island pulses with unstoppable energy.

Now more than four decades strong, Fantasy Fest isn’t just an event — it’s a Key West tradition, a state of mind, and a one-of-a-kind experience you’ll never forget.

October 9, 10 & 11, 2026      Rated G

Based on the popular book by Victoria Kann and Elizabeth Kann, this is the tale of Pinkalicious, who can’t stop eating pink cupcakes despite warnings from her parents. event.description:
Nov 6, 7, 8 & 13, 14, 15, 2026      Rated M

This psychological thriller based on Stephen King’s novel Misery follows successful romance novelist Paul Sheldon, who is rescued from a car crash and wakes up captive in a secluded home owned by his self-identified “number one fan,” Annie Wilkes. While Paul is convalescing, Annie reads the manuscript of his latest book and becomes enraged when she discovers the author has killed off her favorite character, Misery Chastain. Annie forces Paul to write a new Misery novel and he quickly realizes Annie has no intention of letting him go. The irate Annie has Paul writing as if his life depends on it – and it does.

event.description:
Dec 11, 12, 13 & 17, 18, 19, 20, 2026      Rated PG

In the beautiful mountainous kingdom of Arendelle, Princesses Anna and Elsa grow up sheltered inside their castle, isolated from the world and increasingly distant from each other. When Elsa is crowned queen, the magical powers she’s desperately tried to conceal from her sister take control, and she flees into the mountains. As a ferocious winter descends on Arendelle, Anna sets off on an epic journey to find Elsa and bring her home – with the help of hardworking ice harvester Kristoff, his loyal reindeer Sven, and a happy-go-lucky snowman named Olaf.
Full of magic, humor, and a stunning musical score, Frozen is a powerful tale of sisterhood, acceptance, and finding the real meaning of true love.

The show follows the overly optimistic Trolls, constantly with a song on their lips, and the comically pessimistic Bergens, who are only happy when they have Trolls in their stomach.

January 15-24, 2027     Rated PG

Trolls JR. is based on the irreverent DreamWorks Animation movie franchise and features a colorful, wondrous world populated by hilariously unforgettable characters. The show follows the overly optimistic Trolls, constantly with a song on their lips, and the comically pessimistic Bergens, who are only happy when they have Trolls in their stomach.

The Troll thespians in Poppy’s company live by their motto: the show must go on. But when a tyrannical foreign emissary arrives in Bergenland, expectations are raised, forcing the Trolls to totally rework their show or risk being served up in the name of diplomacy by a Chef rehired and out for revenge.

 

If you would like to book a slot for one of our field trip matinees, please contact Autumn (autumnmlct@gmail.com).

event.title: Finding Neverland
event.description:
Feb 19, 20, 21 & 25, 26, 27, 28, 2027   Rated PG

J.M. Barrie, a struggling playwright, encounters a widowed mother, Sylvia Llewelyn Davies and her four sons in Kensington Park. As Barrie befriends the family, he is inspired by their adventures, particularly Peter, who is reluctant to play due to his grief. Barrie helps him to learn to play again and becomes inspired to create a new art form: children’s theatre. But who will pay to see a play about children? Who will play these characters? And how will they make Peter Pan fly?

event.title: The Remains
event.description:
Mar 17 & 18, 2027      Rated M

It’s just another dinner with the in-laws. Just another lasagna, another bottle of wine, maybe even some whiskey if the mood is right – or wrong. Kevin and Theo have been married for ten years, and they have decided its time to tell their nearest and dearest about their life-changing news. Balancing bitter and sweet with a deep sense of love, honesty and irony, The Remains is a story of moving forward together yet apart, wherever the heart may take you.

event.title: A Gentleman’s Guide to Love and Murder
event.description:
Apr 9, 10, 11 & 16, 17, 18, 2027 Rated PG

When the low-born Monty Navarro finds out that he’s eighth in line for an earldom in the lofty D’Ysquith family, he figures his chances of outliving his predecessors are slight and sets off down a far more ghoulish path. Can he knock off his unsuspecting relatives without being caught and become the ninth Earl of Highhurst? And what of love? Because murder isn’t the only thing on Monty’s mind….

A Gentleman’s Guide to Love and Murder is a murderous romp filled with unforgettable music, non-stop laughs and a scene-stealing role for one actor playing all eight of the doomed heirs who meet their ends in the most creative and side-splitting ways. This is a must-produce for any theatre looking for a truly original and fresh new comedy that will delight audiences and leave them begging for more.

event.title: Waiting for Godot
event.description:
May 19 & 20, 2027

Rated PG

Set in a desolate landscape, the play follows two characters, Vladimir and Estragon, as they wait endlessly for the arrival of a mysterious figure named Godot. Through its absurdist humor and profound existential themes, Beckett’s iconic work explores the human condition, the nature of time, and the futility of our search for meaning.
